items.title: Auto dealers launch nationwide campaign with 'E20 fuel is safe to use' banners to reassure customers
items.description: Automobile dealerships across India have begun displaying banners declaring "E20 fuel is safe to use" as part of an industry-wide campaign to counter misinformation over ethanol-blended petrol. Dealers say they have not received a single complaint of E20 fuel damaging vehicle engines despite concerns circulating on social media

items.title: Business in the Week Ahead: July 13-17, 2026
items.description: Two new IPOs will open for subscription. Corporate results, inflation and exports are the other key events, data to track

items.title: Akasa Air pulls plug on Noida–Navi Mumbai flights within two weeks, cites network optimisation
items.description: Akasa Air has suspended its non-stop flights between Noida International Airport and Navi Mumbai International Airport just two weeks after launch, citing network optimisation. The airline plans to resume the service from October 1, even as industry executives point to poor surface connectivity and high airport charges as key hurdles affecting demand

items.title: ONGC approves project to expand strategic crude reserves
items.description: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Ltd., an ONGC subsidiary, operates a 300,000-barrel-a-day refinery in Karnataka state, and ONGC may use the new caverns in conjunction with MRPL for storage.

items.title: Starbucks develops AI-powered in-house software to reduce reliance on Microsoft, IBM
items.description: The coffee chain is building alternatives to a Microsoft system that tracks inventory and an IBM tool that manages maintenance.

items.title: TCS onboards 14,000 campus graduates in Q1FY27 as AI skills reshape hiring
items.description: The fresher intake comes alongside a net addition of 9,279 employees during the quarter, taking TCS' total headcount to 5,93,798.

items.title: India’s ambition of 5,000 GCCs by 2030 realistic, achievable: FM Sitharaman
items.description: India is home to more than 2,100 GCCs, employing over 2.3 million professionals and generating annual revenues of about $100 billion. India went from adding one GCC every week in 2024 to one every day on average now, according to the finance minister.

items.title: OPINION | When the Meter Runs Out: What Meru's withdrawal tells us about the case for litigation funding in India
items.description: Funding converts the right to be heard from a formal entitlement into a practical one. Third-party litigation funding exists precisely to break this asymmetry

items.title: RRP Defense bags Rs 64.31 crore contract from BEL for telescopic day sights
items.description: The contract further strengthens the strategic collaboration between RRP Defense, Meprolight, and Bharat Electronics Ltd while reinforcing India's capability to design, manufacture, and deploy advanced electro-optical systems within the country, RRP Defense said.
